versions.short: The bill would give more time to notify the Indian Health Service's Purchased/Referred Care program about emergency medical care received from a non-IHS provider or facility, extending the deadline from 72 hours to at least 15 days. It would not apply to elderly or disabled individuals, who would keep the 30-day notification requirement for emergency services. Under current rules, the patient, someone acting for them, or the provider must notify the program within 72 hours of starting treatment or being admitted.
